verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature. The only route out is the live, documented REST API (X-API-Key auth, structured JSON), which covers projects and tasks and could be scripted to pull that data. This is a self-built workaround that covers only part of a user's data, not a clean way to export everything and leave. Missing for 10: a first-party bulk or 'export all data' feature, documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/ICS), coverage of calendars, meeting notes, docs and settings, an account-exit or migration guide, and independent confirmation that a complete export works.
